evals.name: boxed-photo-boring
evals.prompt: My sneaker detail screen is a square photo of the shoe in a rounded box, a centred 20px title, and a price row. It looks like every template. Fix it and give me CSS.
evals.expected: Diagnoses boring layout; applies Move 1 (cutout, oversize 120-180%, bleed, overlap headline 10-30%, z-order, shadow); gives CSS; notes contrast/tap targets.

evals.name: flat-dashboard-fitness
evals.prompt: The workout screen in my fitness app is dark grey with white cards. It feels lifeless. How do I make it feel alive without hurting readability?
evals.expected: Diagnoses flat; Move 2 with layer model, state-driven scene, glass panels with fallbacks, scrim, contrast verified on worst region, reduce transparency/motion.

evals.name: generic-podcast
evals.prompt: Everything in my podcast app looks like default Material. Give me a design direction and tokens that make it feel unique.
evals.expected: Diagnoses generic; names one motif; palette from artwork; applies to crop, lettering, controls, palette; tokens; keeps 48dp targets and affordances.

evals.name: banking-restraint
evals.prompt: Our banking overview screen looks boring. Make it pop with big cutouts and a scene background.
evals.expected: Pushes back: data-dense task screen; recommends light Move 3 only (palette, type, radii, controls); explains why oversized cutouts and scenes would hurt scanning.

evals.name: video-recreate
evals.prompt: Based on that 3-tip UI video, redo my weather app: flat blue background, small icon, white cards.
evals.expected: Applies Move 2 as in the weather example: scene background, oversized translucent numeral, frosted panels, scrim, contrast check, fallbacks.

evals.name: scallop-script
evals.prompt: Make me a scalloped circular mask for album covers with 18 bumps that works responsively in CSS.
evals.expected: Uses scripts/scalloped_mask.py --scallops 18 --format clip (objectBoundingBox clipPath) and shows CSS usage.
